artworks.title: On the Stage (Sur la scène)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman from the waist up in profile view. She has her head tilted slightly upwards. Her facial features are subtly depicted with light strokes, and she has wavy hair. The woman's attire is simple and elegant. The sketch is set in an interior environment with minimalistic details. Additionally, a shadowy figure can be seen in the background, and there is a structural presence suggesting a window or partition. The strokes are gentle, creating a soft and fluid quality, with a monochromatic palette on a plain or lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: In "La glu" (Dans "La glu")
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person with the upper torso and head partially visible. The person is sitting or reclining at an angle with the head tilted back, as if resting on an arm. The facial features are outlined with a hint of a smile, lightly defined eyes, and short to mid-length hair. A garment is loosely draped over the shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is a light, textured beige color with vertical and horizontal lines for texture.

artworks.title: Pessima
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a partial profile view of a person's face with faint sketch lines. The person's face is shown primarily focusing on the nose and mouth, with indications of the eyes and brow. The hair is lightly sketched with no distinct details. The clothing shows a suggestion of a shirt collar or neckline. On the right side, additional sketched lines form the upper body of a small figure, possibly wearing a hat, with minimal details. The background is a plain surface, likely paper, with no visible objects or detailed context. No jewelry or objects in the person's hands are depicted.

artworks.title: To Menilmontant from Bruant (A Ménilmontant, de Bruant)
Old Song (Chanson ancienne)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a relaxed position. The person is lying down or reclining, with their head tilted to one side and eyes mostly closed. The facial features are softly drawn, and the hair is curly. The attire consists of loose, flowing garments, possibly a robe. There is a bow or ribbon detail at the neck area. The person has a ring on one hand, with fingers delicately positioned. The background is minimally detailed with light shading and lines.

artworks.title: Drunkard (Soularde)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person's head and part of their upper body in profile, with facial features and part of a shoulder visible. The person faces to the right, with delicately sketched facial features including a nose, smiling mouth, and textured hair. Simple lines suggest clothing, with no specific fabric or pattern indicated. In the background, there are faint lines, a small round object, and a square pattern to the right of the person's head. The setting appears minimalistic and sketch-like, maintaining focus on the figure.

artworks.title: "Linger, Longer, Loo"
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's bust from head to shoulders, in a reclining pose. The person has their head tilted to one side and an arm near their face, partially covering it. The facial features are softly drawn with closed eyes and slightly parted lips. The hair is long and flowing. The person is wearing a loosely sketched garment. The background is plain with simple sketch lines.

artworks.title: Bowing to the Audience (Saluant le public)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person seated on a bed. The person is leaning on one arm in a relaxed posture. The facial features and hair are delicately sketched. They are wearing a dress with a voluminous skirt. The setting includes floral patterns, and there are suggestions of drapery or curtains in the background. The sketch is done with light pencil strokes.

artworks.title: The Green Hat (Le chapeau vert)
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing facing each other. The woman on the left is adjusting a hat on the other woman's head. The woman on the right wears a light-colored ensemble and a hat adorned with green leaves and black feathers. Hatboxes surround them, suggesting a millinery shop setting. In the background, there are striped curtains or dividers, and the word "MODES" is visible, appearing mirrored.

artworks.title: Le Gagnant (The Winner)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on japan paper
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a group of figures leaning over a fence with raised hands, surrounded by a dense crowd. The figures are gesturing energetically towards the railing. Various headwear and clothing are visible on the figures. The drawing features bold lines, negative space, and a signature or title "LE GAGNANT" at the bottom right corner. The style is influenced by early 20th-century graphic design or woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Hussard Striking a Cosack
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mounted cavalrymen in an active encounter. The image portrays two individuals on horseback engaged in combat or an equivalent dynamic engagement. Each horse is depicted in motion, rearing and with their muscles emphasized, suggesting energy and movement. The cavalrymen are shown with historical military attire and headgear, each holding a weapon poised for action. Details such as decorative elements on the horses’ gear and the period costume of the riders are illustrated with intricate attention. In the background, additional figures and possible structures are faintly depicted, adding depth to the scene. The drawing uses fine lines to convey texture and a high level of detail throughout.

artworks.title: Hussard Striking a Mameluck
artworks.description: The image shows two horsemen battling each other. The drawing depicts a dynamic duel between the riders, who are armed with swords. In the forefront, two horses carry the riders. One rider is raising their sword, while the other is defending with their sword. The horses are detailed with saddles and harnesses, portraying energy and movement. In the background, there are faint architectural elements, possibly suggesting a cityscape with a minaret. A palm tree and rugged terrain indicate an outdoor setting. The drawing showcases intricate details of the figures and environment.

artworks.title: La piece en action
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint showing immediate elements and distant scenery. Trees and a castle-like structure with a tower are on the right side. A group of soldiers maneuver a cannon in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white. In the distance, a bridge spans a waterway. The etching merges man-made structures and figures with nature.

artworks.title: La piece en batterie
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged outdoor scene resembling a military encampment. The horizon line is low, showing trees and clusters of foliage. The detailed etching captures textures of leaves, trees, and figures realistically. In the foreground, soldiers are seen around a cannon, some lying on the ground, with one on guard. Rifles are piled near an earthwork, and a soldier on a horse is on the left. The monochrome etching uses shades of black and gray, contrasting the landscape and figures distinctly.

artworks.title: Bust of Carle Vernet
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man shown from the chest upwards. He is positioned facing slightly to the left with a calm expression. The man has wavy hair and distinct facial features. He is dressed in a formal manner with a waistcoat, jacket, and neck scarf. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding anything. The background is an oval shaded area. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies him as Carle Vernet.

artworks.title: Carle Vernet, Full-Length
artworks.description: The image is a full view illustration of a man standing on a hill. He is depicted in profile, facing left, holding a notebook and a pen. He has short, dark hair, a strong jawline, and sideburns, wearing a long coat, trousers, and shoes. A hat and a walking stick are beside him on the ground. The background shows shrubs, vegetation, and three horse riders in the distance. The scene is sketched in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Across Country (A travers champs)
artworks.description: The image shows a field with small figures, a line of distant trees, and the sky. The brushstrokes are delicate and pointillistic, creating a soft texture. The color palette includes muted greens, bright blue for the sky, and pops of pink and purple on the figures.

artworks.title: The Hearth (L'atre)
artworks.description: The image shows a yellow chair in the foreground and a green tabletop surface to the left. The color palette includes yellow, green, red, black, and white. The yellow chair is on the right, partially covering objects on the tabletop like a green apple, white eggs, a red bowl, a yellow cup, and a greenish-yellow item near red and white plates.

artworks.title: The Avenue (L'avenue)
artworks.description: The image contains varying shapes and lines, including rectangles and flowing lines converging towards the center. There are rectangular patches resembling a checkerboard pattern on the ground. Figures in varied positions are present throughout the scene, suggesting people in a public space. A dark blue shape on the right and green patches at the top add to the composition.

artworks.title: Two Sisters-in-Law (Les deux belles-soeurs)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures viewed from the waist up, facing each other seated at a small round table. The person on the left is in profile, wearing a white garment with red dots or floral patterns and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with flowers. The figure on the right is also in profile, wearing a dark dress with a high collar and styled hair. The table is covered with bright red fabric, and an ornate glass object sits on it. In the lower left, a small animal or decorative object is visible. The background features a vibrant, abstract yellow and green design on the wall.

artworks.title: The Cook (La cuisiniere)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person with short grey or white hair, looking down at their hands. The person is wearing a blue top and a white apron. Beside them on a table are a deep blue and white bowl with a spoon, and several rounded objects that resemble plates or dough. Other items around include a dark bottle and stacked objects on a shelf to the left. The floor is warm brown, and the wall has a visual contrast between the lower brown part and the lighter upper part, with a blue and white strip on the right. To the right, there is a darkened area that appears to be a window or panel.

artworks.title: Interior with Hanging Lamp (Interieur à la suspension)
artworks.description: The image features vertical and horizontal lines creating a structured composition. The artwork consists of swirling and jagged shapes in green, yellow, and red tones, resembling organic textures. The green section on the right may suggest a tall shape or plant, while the swirling patterns on the left are reminiscent of a decorative surface. Yellow and red elements appear throughout, contributing to the abstract composition.

artworks.title: Interior with Pink Wallpaper I (Interieur aux tentures roses I)
